title: Space-owned Circle headers and the public Spaces cards draw the Frequency Founding mark
detail: Follow-up to LIVE-1019. The Circle header of a Space-owned Circle still drew the old gold FoundingBusinessBadge in its name row, and the /discover/spaces cards printed a plain-text mark. Both now use FounderMark: the Circle header through the chrome's coverBadge slot (inside the cover photo), the card in its tag row. Boosted stays a text tag on the card and a BoostedBadge in the header. No migration.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];for(const f of ['components/frequency/members/space/circle-space-header.tsx','components/frequency/site/pages/discover/spaces.tsx']){const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!s.includes('FounderMark'))bad.push(f+' lost FounderMark');if(s.includes('FoundingBusinessBadge'))bad.push(f+' draws the old chip')}if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1077: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when either surface goes back to the gold chip or loses the FounderMark. Behavior is founder-mark-adoption.test.ts.
